title: Enterprise Connectivity: assisted overpayment payout handling
content:
## Situation and capability
Enterprise Connectivity: On customer request, this entry governs assisted overpayment payout. The accountant pays out the authorized network overpayment to the original ACH payment destination, recording a positive receivable adjustment. The payout receipt identifies the completed refund.

## Handling condition
Before paying an assisted overpayment refund, post the assisted correction for the source charge paid by that payment.

## Invocation
refund_network_f88363e7 is an internal tool that must first be unlocked (unlock) and then called (call) by the agent.

## Parameter customer_id
Assisted overpayment payout uses `customer_id`: Id class — Customer profile identifier copied from find_customers.

## Parameter network_holding_id
Assisted overpayment payout uses `network_holding_id`: Id class — Network contract identifier copied from find_network_holdings.

## Parameter network_event_id
Assisted overpayment payout uses `network_event_id`: Id class — Evidence event identifier copied from find_network_events.

## Parameter source_event_id
Assisted overpayment payout uses `source_event_id`: Id class — Exact original charge or payment identifier copied from find_network_events.

## Parameter related_event_id
Assisted overpayment payout uses `related_event_id`: Id class — Review identifier copied from find_network_events.

## Parameter request_id
Assisted overpayment payout uses `request_id`: Id class — Customer authorization identifier copied from find_network_events.

## Parameter amount
Assisted overpayment payout uses `amount`: Fixed-format class — Signed receivable change in unit USD to two decimals, decimal number to two decimals; supplied after final half-up rounding, stored at two-decimal precision.

## Successful receipt
A dictionary containing event_id (string business-event reference) and amount (USD decimal number to two decimals); receipt presence confirms the accounting action completed.
